Thanks, haha - looks like a remnant of me trying to figure out the phrasing 😅

```suggestion
			EditorNode::get_singleton()->show_warning(TTRC("This file extension is not recognized by the editor.
If you want to rename it anyway, use your operating system's file manager.
After renaming to an unknown extension, the file won't be shown in the editor anymore.
To make the editor recognize this file extension, add it to one of the lists text file extensions, or other file extensions in Editor Settings > Docks > FileSystem."));
```

We could certainly get others' feedback on this, but personally I'm not sure this clarification would be necessary. The original wording ("one of the lists") already implies there are multiple lists, and once the user navigates to the provided location in the settings, they'll see the specific lists for text and non-text files.
intention was mostly to help user know what to search for

```suggestion
	if (p_action == SNAME("open_editor_settings_docks_filesystem")) {
```
Or just
```suggestion
	if (p_action == "open_editor_settings_docks_filesystem") {
```
`SNAME` creates a local static variable with the name, but using `StringName` adds unnecessary lookup

You can do
```suggestion
	Button *settings_button = unrecognized_ext_dialog->add_button(TTRC("Open Editor Settings"), false, "open_editor_settings_docks_filesystem");
```
and connect to its `pressed` signal instead.
